issue.title: File writes: two paths with different rules; bare filenames become /name at the root
issue.symptom: 2026-11-16 Discord DM: 'write approval_test.txt in your sandbox'. Tool routing chose file(write, path=/approval_test.txt) (root). agent_core's tool-routing file.write short-circuit (agent_core.py ~10741) writes LOCALLY in gaia-core via mcp_client.ai_write with no human approval; its allowlist (/sandbox /shared /knowledge /tmp /logs) blocked the root path with a bare 'path outside allowed directories'. She then wrote a raw invented <tool_call>{"tool": "sandbox"...} with a self-narrated 'Yes. Writing approved.', then said she has no sandbox filesystem. The inline/stream path instead goes to gaia-mcp and needs a TOTP approval. Also /sandbox is not mounted in gaia-core (it is in gaia-mcp), so a tool-routed /sandbox write lands in gaia-core's container filesystem and is lost on recreate. Decide: one write path (through gaia-mcp + approval, or a deliberate no-approval scope); map bare/root filenames to /sandbox; tell her the writable folders when a write is refused.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix

# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_routed_write_goes_through_mcp_diq7.py
"""A tool-routed file write asks for the human's code like any other (diq7).

2026-11-16: tool routing wrote files locally in gaia-core with no approval and
its own path rules, while her inline tool calls went to gaia-mcp and needed a
TOTP code. The same request was refused in one path and approved in the other.
"""
from types import SimpleNamespace

from gaia_core.cognition import agent_core as ac
from gaia_core.cognition import approval_reply


def test_routed_write_parks_in_mcp_and_never_writes_locally(monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(ac.mcp_client, "call_jsonrpc",
                        lambda method, params: calls.append((method, dict(params))) or
                        {"ok": False, "pending_approval": True, "action_id": "a-9"})
    monkeypatch.setattr(ac.mcp_client, "ai_write",
                        lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("wrote locally")))
    core = object.__new__(ac.AgentCore)
    core.config = SimpleNamespace(constants={"TOOL_ROUTING": {"ALLOW_WRITE_TOOLS": True}})
    core.session_manager = _Sessions()
    tool = ac.SelectedTool(tool_name="file", params={"action": "write", "path": "/approval_test.txt",
                                                     "content": "hello"}, selection_confidence=0.9)
    out = core._execute_mcp_tool(tool, session_id="dm1")
    assert calls == [("file", {"action": "write", "path": "/approval_test.txt", "content": "hello"})]
    assert out.output["pending_approval"] and "authenticator code" in out.output["message"]
    assert core.session_manager.get_session_meta("dm1", approval_reply.KEY)["action_id"] == "a-9"

# candidates/gaia-mcp/tests/test_approval_preflight_96xm.py
"""A human is only asked to approve a call that could run (96xm, 2026-11-16).

A write to /approval_test.txt was approved with a real authenticator code,
then refused by the path allowlist; the approval was spent and the chat said
the code was wrong.
"""
import asyncio

from gaia_mcp import server
from gaia_mcp.tools import preflight

from .conftest import totp_code


def test_a_file_named_at_the_root_means_the_sandbox(approval_store):
    # diq7: "approval_test.txt in your sandbox" came through as /approval_test.txt
    from gaia_mcp.tools import _checked_write_path
    assert str(_checked_write_path("/approval_test.txt")).endswith("/sandbox/approval_test.txt")
    assert preflight("file", {"action": "write", "path": "/approval_test.txt"}, approval_store) is None
